SELECT rm.repair_id AS repairId, rm.repair_request_id AS repairRequestId, rm.technician_id AS technicianId, rm.repair_price AS repairPrice, rm.payment_status AS paymentStatus, rm.repair_notes AS repairNotes, rm.created_at AS createdAt, rr.phone_model AS phoneModel, CASE rr.request_status WHEN 0 THEN '待维修' WHEN 1 THEN '维修中' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' ELSE '未知状态' END AS statusName, u.user_name AS userName FROM yjx_repair_management rm LEFT JOIN yjx_repair_request rr ON rm.repair_request_id = rr.request_id LEFT JOIN yjx_user u ON rr.user_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND (#{userId} IN (1,3) OR rm.technician_id = #{userId})
AND ( rr.phone_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR rm.repair_notes LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY
rm.created_at rm.repair_id u.user_name rm.created_at
DESC ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM yjx_repair_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
